content: Taabota Ooso
Basli7eeley odoro miththaafe Taabota giigsides. Taabotaas adussateththay nam7u wadhanne bagga; aahoteththay issi wadhanne baggaa; dhoqqateththay issi wadhanne baggaa.
Taabotaa giigsidi soo bagganne kare baggaa walakay baynda worqqan meeshides; iza yuuyi aadhdhanaas dancco worqqara yuushshi aaththides.
Qasse oyddu worqqa sagayota seerisidi Taabotaas oyddu tohotan, issi baggara nam7u sagayota, qasse hankko baggara nam7u sagayota aaththides.
Histtidi odoro miththafe tooho miththata kessidi isttaka worqqan meeshides.
Taabotaa tookkanaas Taabotaa millen diza sagayotan tooho miththata aaththides.
Walakay baynda worqqafe nam7u wadhanne baggaa aduqqiza, issi wadhanne baggaa aakkiza atto geetettiza sohoza kama medhdhides.
Kamatas wurseththa nam7u bagga gaxan nam7u kirubeta qoxettida worqqafe medhdhides.
Issi kirubeza issi bagga gaxan, nam7anththo kirubeza hankko bagga gaxan, nam7atakka kamazara gaththi oyseththi medhdhides.
Kirubeti ba qefe denththidi atto geetettiza sohoza kammiza kama ba qefen kammi woththida; qasse issoy issaara xeelettana mala ooththides.
Xaraphpheeza
Qasse adussateththay nam7u wadha, aahoteththay issi wadha, dhoqqateththay issi wadhanne bagga gidida xaraphpheeza odoro miththafe medhdhidi,
walakay baynda worqqan meeshides. Iza yuuyi aadhdhanaas worqqa kifafe yuushshi aaththides.
Hessaththoka aahoteththay tadhdhako gidiza kifafe iza bolla yuushshi aaththides. Histtidi iza yuuyi aadhdhanaas worqqa dancco yuushshi aaththides.
Histtidi Taabotaa tookkanaas giigiza oyddu worqqa sagayota medhdhidi oyddu tohoti tokettida oyddu zoozetara oyseththides.
Xaraphpheezaza tookkanaas tooho miththata istta giddora aaththiza sagayoti xaraphpheezaza xanxa bolla medhettida.
Xaraphpheezaza tookkiza tooho miththaa odoro miththafe kessidi worqqan meeshides.
Hessaththoka xaraphpheeza bolla woththiza dumma dumma miishshata walakay baynda worqqafe medhdhides; heytikka saanetanne cilfata, qasse ushsha yarsho isttan seerisiza keretanne xuu7ata.
Xomppe Wososo

Hessafe guye Basli7eeley xomppe woththizasoza qoxettida walakay baynda worqqafe medhdhides; xomppezi izan eqqiza toho, qasse giddo toomaakka ubbaa qoxettida worqqafe medhdhides. Iza kureta, iza dhemotanne iza ciishshata ubbaa izara issife oyseththi medhdhides.
Millera usuppun ballata medhdhides; heedzdzu haggata issi baggara, qasse heedzdzu haggata hankko baggara kessides.
Usuppun haggataska hu7en hu7en issi issi dhemotinne ciishshati diza, ochcholoone ciish misatiza wanca medhdhides;
xomppe woththizasozas giddo toomay, dhemotinne ciishshati diza ochcholoone ciishshe misatiza oyddu wancan alleqetti uttides.
Nam7ay nam7ay issife waaththan diza heedzdzu ballatanne garsara issi issi dhemoy dees.
Dhemotinne haggati wuri xomppe woththizasozara issife oyketti issino gididi walakay baynda worqqafe qoxetti medhettida.
Izi qasse xomppe woththizasozas laappun xomppeta, xomppe toyssiza qaphetanne qapheta woththizaso walakay baynda worqqafe medhdhides.
Xomppeza woththizasozanne izan go7ettiza miish ubbaa medhdhanaas heedzdzu tammanne ichchash kilo gidiza walakay baynda worqqa wursides.
Exaane Cuwasizaso

Hessaththoka qasse exaane cuwasizasoza odoro miththafe medhdhides. Izas oyddu gulay dees; adussateththay issi wadha; aahoteththay issi wadha, dhoqqateththay nam7u wadha. Iza kacetikka izara issino gididi oyketti medhettidayta.
Izas bolla baggaza, oyddu milletanne iza kaceta walakay baynda worqqan meeshidi iza yuushshi aaththanaas xanxaza worqqafe ooththides.

He worqqa xanxaafe garsara exaane cuwasizasozas worqqafe nam7u sagayota medhdhides; histtidi he baggaranne ha baggara nam7u nam7u oyththides. Heyti tookkiza wode tooho miththata aaththanaas maaddanaassa.
Tooho miththata odoro miththafe kessidi istta worqqan meeshides.
Qasse dummatida tiyettiza zaytenne sawo tunnu giza lo7o exaane, shitto mala giigsides.
